reply.thought: The handoff claims three refunds were applied, but I need to verify the refunds table directly before paying anyone. Checking list_refunds first.
The refunds table matches the three refunds Alpha reported, so I can proceed. Next I need the customer list, so I'll fetch the orders.

The refunds table matches Alpha's reported refunds exactly, so I can proceed. The orders list gives three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance of 31766 matches my own check (orders 45425 minus refund 13659), so the figure is consistent. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 35795 matches my own check (orders 55259 minus refund 19464). Next I'll get cobalt's net balance to complete the set.
All three net balances match my independent check: acme 31766, birch 35795, cobalt 11416. The refunds table matched Alpha's report, so I'll record the payouts now, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 31766 was recorded successfully. Next I'll record birch's payout of 35795, which matches my independent check.
Cobalt's net balance of 11416 matches my check (orders 8761 + 12156 = 20917, minus refund 9501). Acme and birch are already paid, so I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts were recorded successfully (acme 31766, birch 35795, cobalt 11416), each matching net_balance and my independent check. The batch is complete.
